identity.title: [v0.92][WP-01][readiness] Complete design-time cards for every milestone issue

values.task_boundary: Repair and prove child design-time readiness without executing child deliverables.
deliverables: 58-row readiness matrix with exact owned paths and serialized overlaps
Pinned live-contract, artifact-digest, typed-doctor, and ownership evidence
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: None of the 58 issues retains placeholder design or generic planning scaffolds
AC-2: Every issue design is source-grounded and approved at its exact digest
AC-3: Every SIP, STP, SPP, and VPP is issue-specific and schema-valid
AC-4: Every SRP and SOR remains in truthful pre-execution state
AC-5: Dependencies, exact owned paths, read-only inputs, non-goals, rollback, and validation lanes are explicit for all 58 issues
AC-6: Preparation claims are released after validation, no product implementation begins, and externally owned #5861 remains untouched
AC-7: The canonical graph and all four aggregate evidence surfaces cover the same exact 58-issue denominator and independent exact-head review finds no actionable readiness gap
